artworks.title: William Campbell, Abingdon, Virginia
artworks.medium: gelatin silver print
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Robert B. Menschel
artworks.description: The image shows an older man sitting, with his torso visible from the waist up. He is seated facing slightly to the left, with his arms crossed casually. His facial features include a prominent, long, and full beard, and he has a large hat that casts a shadow over his eyes. His hair blends into the beard and appears to be as long and full as the beard itself. He is dressed in a light-colored, long-sleeved shirt underneath a pair of dungarees, with one visible pocket on the chest. The background is plain and subdued, with a textured surface behind him.

artworks.title: Travellers in a Woodland Glade
artworks.medium: watercolor with graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a woodland scene with a forest floor of fallen branches and a large tree trunk. Tall trees frame the view, and a path winds through the forest. In the distance, a group of travelers, including a child, pause on the path. The color palette includes earthy browns and greens, with dappled light filtering through the canopy.

artworks.title: A Ruined Abbey by a Waterfall
artworks.medium: watercolor and gouache with graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund

artworks.title: Seated Acolyte
artworks.medium: etching with roulette and aquatint (artist's proof)
artworks.creditLine: Purchased as the Gift of Ann and Matthew Nimetz
artworks.description: The image shows a boy sitting in an ornate chair with his full body visible. He is leaning slightly to his left with his arms resting on the armrests. The boy has short, curly hair and a neutral expression. He is wearing a loose garment with a darker collar and his legs are covered with darker fabric. There is no visible jewelry or objects. The background consists of a textured, shadowy wall and a minimalistic floor.

artworks.title: Ancient Roman Ruins Overgrown with Trees and Bushes
artworks.medium: watercolor and gouache over graphite on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image depicts a landscape with rocky terrain and dense foliage. The viewpoint is from the bottom of a valley looking upward towards natural rock formations. The horizon is not clearly visible, with the rocky cliffs serving as a boundary against the sky. The painting style appears to be watercolor, showing soft brushstrokes indicating movement in the foliage. The color scheme includes muted greens, browns, and light yellows for highlights. The sky is depicted in blue and pale tones, contrasting with the earthy hues of the cliffs and trees. There are cave-like openings in the rock formations, surrounded by lush vegetation.

artworks.title: A Study of Pine Trees
artworks.medium: watercolor and gouache over graphite with pen and black ink on blue gray prepared paper
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image depicts a group of tall, slender trees on a slope. The viewpoint is slightly elevated, with a focus on the trees. The horizon is not visible. The trees on the left are detailed with vibrant colors, while those on the right are sketched with outlines. The color scheme consists of earthy tones for the trees and pale blue for the sky.

artworks.title: A Peep through the Arch, Wissahickon
artworks.medium: stereoscopic albumen silver prints
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Funds from Clinton and Jean Wright
artworks.description: This image shows an old sepia-toned stereographic photograph of a scene under a stone arch bridge. The viewpoint is from beneath the arch looking out towards a small creek. The horizon is low beyond the arch and is obscured by bare winter trees. The stone arch is textured with visible individual bricks forming a classic structure. The photo has a monochromatic palette of subdued browns and grays. Closest to the viewer are uneven stone and rocky surfaces under the arch. In the distance, there is a figure relaxing against a slope beside the creek. The water in the creek reflects light, providing contrast to the darker tones of the stones and trees.

artworks.title: Head of a Woman
artworks.medium: conté crayon and pastel on buff paper laid down on board
artworks.creditLine: Gift of The Robert and Mary M. Looker Family Collection

artworks.title: Standing Nude with a Patterned Robe
artworks.medium: opaque watercolor and charcoal on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of The Robert and Mary M. Looker Family Collection
artworks.description: This painting shows a woman standing, facing left, her face turned away from us. She is nude, with pale skin the same color as the paper beneath, highlighted with areas of rosy pink and bright teal.  She has auburn hair styled in a bun at the back of her head. The woman holds a colorful fabric with her right arm, patterned with areas of red, yellow, purple, white, and green.

artworks.title: Bridge near Collector’s House, Shungavellor, India
artworks.medium: waxed-paper negative
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Betsy Karel
artworks.description: The image features a multi-arched stone bridge extending diagonally across the scene from the left side to the right. The horizon is low, obscured by the bridge and foliage, creating a sense of enclosure. The bridge sits atop stone pillars reflected in water, creating symmetrical arch shapes. Closest to us are textured stones and foliage on the left. The color palette is a sepia tone, with dark shadows and muted highlights.

artworks.title: The Virgin Crowned by an Angel
artworks.medium: black chalk, pen and brown ink with brown wash, heightened with white gouache on blue laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Donald Stone in honor of the Prouté Family
artworks.description: The image shows a partial figure of a woman from the waist up. Her head is gently tilted to the left with closed eyes, and she wears a veil over her head and shoulders. She is dressed in a flowing garment with a circular brooch at her chest. Next to her is a cherubic figure with a youthful face, short curly hair, and small wings. The cherub is in a dynamic pose with one arm outstretched and the other bent towards its chest. The background is a plain textured surface.

artworks.title: A Standing Sibyl with a Scroll
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Purchased as the Gift of Joan and David Maxwell
artworks.description: The image shows a full-length drawing of a stylized person with unique facial features and hair. The individual is depicted tilting slightly, with swirling lines around them that could represent clouds. The person is dressed in flowing clothing holding a long, slender object, possibly a quill, and a sheet of paper. The background consists of swirling lines resembling clouds or fabric on a plain parchment.

artworks.title: The Flagellation of Christ
artworks.medium: oil paint over pen and black ink(?) on two pieces of laid paper mounted on fabric and wood
artworks.creditLine: Pepita Milmore Memorial Fund
artworks.description: The painting depicts a group of figures in a scene of intense action and emotion. Several male bodies are shown, with a man at the center standing partially turned to the side with his arms tied to a column. Other men are around him in various positions. One is about to strike with a raised whip, while another stands behind with a similarly fierce posture. The expressions are stern and focused, emphasizing muscular builds. A crowd gathers in the background, with some figures clothed in robes, including a helmeted soldier. Above the central group, a trio of winged angels emerges from the clouds. The scene is set in a city-like environment with architectural structures and rooftops visible in the background, against a sky filled with dramatic clouds. The color palette is dominated by brown and ochre tones, giving the image a sepia-like quality.

artworks.title: Motorcycle [verso]
artworks.medium: graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Miss Emily Sargent and Mrs. Francis Ormond, sisters of the artist)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a bicycle. The drawing is executed in a simple, minimalist style using a series of light pencil lines. The focus appears to be on depicting the front view of the bicycle, emphasizing elements such as the handlebars, the front wheel, and the front fork. The lines are light and sketchy, giving the drawing a spontaneous and fluid feel. The drawing is presented on a plain, neutral-colored background.

artworks.title: The Grimsel Pass
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with gray wash
artworks.creditLine: Purchased as the Gift of Ivan and Winifred Phillips
artworks.description: The image shows a mountainous landscape from an elevated perspective. The horizon is near the top, with jagged peaks against the sky. The brushstrokes are detailed, capturing the texture of the mountains and the play of light and shadow. The color palette is primarily gray. In the foreground, a group with oxen and seated individuals suggests a moment of rest. The mountains in the distance ascend towards the background where clouds mingle with the peaks.

artworks.title: The Carrefour de l'Aiguille in the Forest of Fontainebleau
artworks.medium: red chalk on laid paper, laid down on old mount
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund and Phillips Family Fund
artworks.description: The image displays a natural landscape with trees, foliage, and a cloudy sky. The trees are detailed with sepia-toned brushstrokes, creating texture and depth. The color palette is warm and brown, giving a monochromatic look. The background shows open fields and more trees, with wispy clouds in the sky.

artworks.title: Landscape with Two Trees
artworks.medium: etching with engraving on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image is an etching showing an elevated panoramic view. Two tall trees frame a coastal town, with a bridge, boats in the bay, and various architectural structures. Hills and buildings are visible further away. The sky has swirling clouds created through etching strokes. The artwork's color palette is monochrome, emphasizing light and shadow contrasts in typical etched print style.

artworks.title: Clouds [verso]
artworks.medium: graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Miss Emily Sargent and Mrs. Francis Ormond, sisters of the artist)
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of land under a cloudy sky. The horizon is visible near the lower edge, where the land meets the sky. Some clouds have streaks suggesting rain. The sketch is detailed with pencil lines, showing the textures of clouds and land. The color scheme is primarily grayscale. Darker forms in the foreground may represent vegetation or terrain. Farther away, the horizon is subtly shaded with the sky above.

artworks.title: Saint Roch with a Donor
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet: 37.1 × 26.1 cm (14 5/8 × 10 1/4 in.), trimmed within platemark
artworks.creditLine: Purchased as the Gift of Bert Freidus
artworks.description: The image shows two men. One man is standing upright with his right arm bent upwards towards his chest. He has strong facial features, a defined jawline, a short beard, and curly hair. He wears a loose garment draped over his shoulders and a cloak. The other man is kneeling and looking up at the standing man. He has an elderly appearance with a pronounced nose, a beard, and short hair, and wears a fur-trimmed coat. Next to the kneeling man is a dog looking towards the standing man. The background features textured foliage, trees, shrubbery, clouds, and sunlight.

artworks.title: Studies of Peasants with Wheelbarrows [verso]
artworks.medium: graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Miss Emily Sargent and Mrs. Francis Ormond, sisters of the artist)
artworks.description: The image is a sketch showing several figures and body parts. The central figure, seen from the back in full view, appears to be standing upright and using crutches, wearing a wide-brimmed hat. Other smaller figures to the right are depicted standing and walking forward, wearing short tunics or dresses, with visible legs and arms. In the top right corner, there is a sketch of what seems to be a head or face viewed side-on. On the left side, there is a partial study of an arm. The background is plain with no additional context or environment details.

artworks.title: Attila at the Gates of Rome
artworks.artist: Giovanni Battista Bracelli, after Alessandro Algardi
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper [proof]
artworks.creditLine: Purchased as the Gift of Bert Freidus

artworks.title: Studies of Peasants [verso]
artworks.medium: graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Miss Emily Sargent and Mrs. Francis Ormond, sisters of the artist)
artworks.description: The sketch depicts three figures: two full-bodied walking side by side and one in a close-up. The two walking figures are carrying a single basket between them. The figures are drawn in a dynamic walking pose with knee-length skirts and head coverings. Their facial features are minimal. The close-up figure on the right has detailed facial features, short curly hair, and is not shown wearing jewelry or holding objects. The background is plain paper with some aging spots.

artworks.title: Tree Trunks [verso]
artworks.medium: graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Miss Emily Sargent and Mrs. Francis Ormond, sisters of the artist)
artworks.description: The image shows a diffuse area of gray speckles covering much of the paper, creating an abstract texture that fades out toward the edges. In the upper right portion, two vertical, narrow columns are sketched lightly, resembling intricate, twisted rope patterns.

artworks.title: Rest on the Flight into Egypt
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund and Katharine Shepard Fund
artworks.description: The image shows three adult figures and a child. One figure is standing upright, wrapped in a draped garment, looking downward with long hair and a beard. Another figure is kneeling, one hand near the ground, while a smaller figure is nearby. This kneeling figure has hair pulled back and flowing garments. A child stands with their back turned, holding onto vegetation. The background features a large, rough-hewn rock with a twisted tree branch above.
